about: Every Suno take made for this reel, kept so prompts and results can be compared and unused takes reused. Audio lives in the suno-archive release (archive links); suno_url opens the original at full quality.

takes.title: Open Chord
takes.note: D minor like the bronze tone; calmest passage (under one onset every 6 s); ends on an open D-A chord ringing to silence. Late calm stretch under 0-13 s, silence 13-22 s, own ending under 22-36 s
takes.structure_cues:
[Instrumental]
[Intro: single low piano note, drone fades in]
[Verse: three-note piano figure, wide space between notes]
[Break: near silence, only the bowl ringing]
[Build: cello enters on a rising fifth, still quiet]
[Outro: piano returns, ends on an open suspended chord, let it ring out]
